verdict.rationale: The pack documents the Marketing Emails API, including GET endpoints and post-send statistics, plus an official MCP server. Nothing in it describes minting scoped, read-only, or permission-limited API credentials that could read analytics while blocking sends. Read endpoints are not credential scoping, so the axis applies but has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can mint scoped or read-only API credentials so an agent or contractor can read analytics without the power to send
